Name: Pethuel
Summary: Pethuel is named only as the father of the prophet Joel (Joel 1:1). Nothing else is told of him.
KeyStory: Pethuel's only mention is as Joel's father, in the opening line of his son's prophecy.
LifeLesson: Like Beeri, Pethuel is remembered for a son God used. Faithful obscurity is still faithfulness.
